description: Synthetic past negotiation rounds — one row per specific ask made to a vendor, with its outcome. Ground truth for the win-probability/odds layer (agents/odds.py). Deliberately correlated, not random: vendors with weaker performance/compliance standing concede more on price; top performers concede more on non-price asks (SLA, contract term) than on price, since price is where their leverage is strongest. Dates are all before the current policy date (2026-08-17).

records.ask_details: Requested 8% reduction on a 50-unit laptop order.
records.notes: Top performer (96.4% on-time); held firm on price, cited strong demand.

records.ask_details: Requested a formal 24-hour DOA (dead-on-arrival) replacement SLA.
records.notes: Low-cost concession for them relative to their existing quality process.

records.ask_details: Proposed a 24-month standing agreement in exchange for volume pricing.
records.notes: Agreed to 18 months with a smaller discount than requested.

records.ask_details: Requested 5% off a recurring quarterly supplies order.
records.notes: 98.1% on-time, low defect rate — little incentive to concede on price.

records.ask_details: Requested Net 45 instead of standard Net 30.
records.notes: Non-price ask, low cost for an established relationship.

records.ask_details: Requested a 10% blended rate reduction for a multi-quarter engagement.
records.notes: Settled at 4% reduction with a volume commitment.

records.ask_details: Requested defined milestone acceptance criteria.
records.notes: Standard ask for a consulting engagement, low friction.

records.ask_details: Requested 6% reduction citing a competitor quote.
records.notes: 93.7% on-time, mid-tier leverage; settled at 3%.

records.ask_details: Offered a 12-month volume commitment for a per-unit discount.
records.notes: Predictable demand was valuable to them.

records.ask_details: Requested 5% reduction on the annual maintenance contract.
records.notes: Incident-free 24-month record gave them leverage to hold price.

records.ask_details: Requested extended workmanship warranty on a capital repair.
records.notes: Low marginal cost to them for a relationship-preserving concession.

records.ask_details: Requested a per-shipment rate reduction on a new lane.
records.notes: 97.3% on-time; strong performer, held rate card.

records.ask_details: Requested a guaranteed 3-day expedited option at standard rate.
records.notes: Offered at a modest surcharge instead of standard rate.

records.ask_details: Requested 10% reduction citing a competitor's better cert standing.
records.notes: Below-average performer (89.6% on-time, 2.1% defect); conceded to retain the account.

records.ask_details: Requested a formal remediation plan tied to the lapsed ISO 27001 cert.
records.notes: Cert had already expired by this date; vendor agreed to a written renewal timeline to keep the relationship.

records.ask_details: Requested 7% reduction on a bulk fastener order.
records.notes: 90.5% on-time, mid-low tier; conceded readily.

records.ask_details: Requested proactive notice of any certification lapses going forward.
records.notes: ISO 9001 was nearing expiry at time of ask; vendor agreed given the timing.

records.ask_details: Requested 5% off a data analytics retainer.
records.notes: 4.6/5 satisfaction gave them some leverage; settled at 2%.

records.ask_details: Requested faster dashboard turnaround on standard requests.
records.notes: Newer vendor relationship, motivated to demonstrate responsiveness.

records.ask_details: Requested 5% off a print-services contract renewal.
records.notes: 97.8% on-time, strong performer, held price.

records.ask_details: Requested a defined reprint policy for quality misses.
records.notes: Standard, low-cost concession.

records.ask_details: Requested 6% off a composite panel order.
records.notes: 92.9% on-time, mid-tier; settled at 2.5%.

records.ask_details: Proposed 12-month standing order for a modest per-unit discount.
records.notes: Predictability was valuable to a mid-tier supplier.

records.ask_details: Requested a rate reduction on an expedited lane.
records.notes: 95.8% on-time, strong performer, held rate card.

records.ask_details: Requested extended claims window on damaged shipments.
records.notes: Extended from 7 to 10 days instead of the requested 14.

records.ask_details: Requested 5% off landscaping and security services bundle.
records.notes: Settled at 2% with a longer term commitment.

records.ask_details: Requested defined incident-response time commitments.
records.notes: Low-cost formalization of existing practice.

records.ask_details: Requested 8% reduction on the annual advisory retainer.
records.notes: 88.4% on-time, weakest performer of the services category, and under an active compliance monitoring flag — conceded quickly.

records.ask_details: Requested a formal engagement structure to address the split-PO monitoring flag.
records.notes: Vendor cooperative given the compliance context — strong incentive to demonstrate clean process.

records.ask_details: We offered quarterly prepayment in exchange for a further 5% discount.
records.notes: Cash-flow-motivated concession, consistent with their smaller scale.

records.ask_details: Requested 8% reduction on a data center hardware refresh.
records.notes: Top-performing vendor in the category (98.6% on-time); held price, cited demand.

records.ask_details: Requested Net 45 on a large capital order.
records.notes: Non-price ask, low cost for a stable long-tenured relationship.

records.ask_details: Requested a further 5% off a repeat order.
records.notes: Consistent with prior pattern — this vendor does not concede on price.
